local src="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" rl="" dir=""
if command -v readlink >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -L "$src" ]; then
  rl="$(readlink "$src" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [ -n "$rl" ] && case "$rl" in /*) src="$rl" ;; *) src="$(dirname "$src")/$rl" ;; esac
fi
dir="$(cd "$(dirname "$src")" >/dev/null 2>&1 && pwd || printf '%s' "$(dirname "$src")")"
printf '%s' "$dir"

local dir="${1:-}"
local perm="${2:-700}"
if [ -z "$dir" ]; then
  return 1
fi
if [ -L "$dir" ]; then
  log_error "TMP" "Directory is a symlink: $dir"
  if [ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" = "$0" ]; then
    exit "${BASH4LLM_ERR_TMP:-15}"
  else
    return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_TMP:-15}"
  fi
fi
if [ ! -d "$dir" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$dir" 2>/dev/null || {
    log_error "TMP" "Cannot create directory: $dir"
    if [ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" = "$0" ]; then
      exit "${BASH4LLM_ERR_TMP:-15}"
    else
      return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_TMP:-15}"
    fi
  }
  chmod "$perm" "$dir" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

local option="${1:-}"
local count="${2:-0}"
if [ "$count" -lt 2 ]; then
  log_error "ARGS" "Option $option requires an argument"
  exit "${BASH4LLM_ERR_TMP:-15}"
fi
printf '%s' "${BASH4LLM_CONFIG_DIR%/}"
printf '%s\n' "$(canonical_config_dir)/provider"

local prov="${1:-}"
printf '%s\n' "$(canonical_config_dir)/model.${prov}"

local cfgdir=""
if type canonical_config_dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  cfgdir="$(canonical_config_dir)"
else
  cfgdir="${BASH4LLM_CONFIG_DIR:-${BASH4LLM_DIR%/}/config}"
fi
printf '%s' "${cfgdir%/}/provider-url"

local var="${1:-}"
var="${var#"${var%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
var="${var%"${var##*[![:space:]]}"}"
printf '%s' "$var"

local fn="${1:-}"
[ -n "$fn" ] || return 1
declare -F "$fn" >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! (unset -f "$fn" 2>/dev/null)

local prov="${1:-${PROVIDER:-groq}}"
prov="${prov//[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/}"
[ -n "$prov" ] || prov="groq"
MODELS_FILE="${BASH4LLM_MODELS_DIR:-}/${prov}.txt"
if [ ! -s "$MODELS_FILE" ] && [ -s "${BASH4LLM_MODELS_DIR:-}/models.txt" ]; then
  MODELS_FILE="${BASH4LLM_MODELS_DIR:-}/models.txt"
fi
export MODELS_FILE

local prov="${PROVIDER:-groq}"
local name="${1:-}"
local cache_key="${prov}||${name}"
if [ -n "${BASH4LLM_MODEL_CACHE[$cache_key]:-}" ]; then
  printf '%s' "${BASH4LLM_MODEL_CACHE[$cache_key]}"
  return 0
fi
local normalized=""
local trimmed="${name#"${name%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
trimmed="${trimmed%"${trimmed##*[![:space:]]}"}"
trimmed="${trimmed//$'\r'/}"
if type "normalize_model_${prov}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  normalized="$( "normalize_model_${prov}" "$trimmed" 2>/dev/null || true )"
fi
if [ -z "$normalized" ]; then
  normalized="$trimmed"
  normalized="${normalized#models/}"
  if [ "$prov" != "gemini" ]; then
    normalized="${normalized#$prov}"
  fi
  while [[ "$normalized" == [[:space:]:/~_-]* ]]; do
    normalized="${normalized#?}"
  done
fi
normalized="${normalized//[^a-zA-Z0-9._\/:+@=-]/}"
BASH4LLM_MODEL_CACHE["$cache_key"]="$normalized"
printf '%s' "$normalized"

local status_type="${1:-ERROR}"
local err_code="${2:-13}"
local reason_code="${3:-UNKNOWN_ERROR}"
local msg="${4:-}"
local now_ts=""
now_ts="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ 2>/dev/null || echo "")"
jq -c -n \
  --arg status "$status_type" \
  --argjson code "$err_code" \
  --arg reason "$reason_code" \
  --arg message "$msg" \
  --arg ts "$now_ts" \
  '{bash4llm_status:$status, code:($code|tonumber), reason:$reason, message:$message, timestamp:$ts}' >&2 || \
printf '{"bash4llm_status":"%s","code":%d,"reason":"%s","message":"%s","timestamp":"%s"}\n' \
  "$status_type" "$err_code" "$reason_code" "$msg" "$now_ts" >&2
printf '%s: ' "$SCRIPT_NAME"

local code="${1:-INFO}" msg="${2:-}"
if [ "${DEBUG:-0}" -eq 1 ]; then
  if [ "$code" = "SECURITY" ]; then
    printf '%s%sSECURITY%s: %s\n' "$(log_prefix)" "${C_BMAGENTA:-}" "${C_RST}" "$msg" >&2
  else
    printf '%s%sINFO%s: %s: %s\n' "$(log_prefix)" "${C_GREEN}" "${C_RST}" "$code" "$msg" >&2
  fi
fi
if [ -n "$BASH4LLM_LOG" ]; then printf '%s INFO %s %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$code" "$msg" >>"$BASH4LLM_LOG" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

local code="${1:-WARN}" msg="${2:-}"
printf '%s%sWARN%s: %s: %s\n' "$(log_prefix)" "${C_BYELLOW}" "${C_RST}" "$code" "$msg" >&2
if [ -n "$BASH4LLM_LOG" ]; then printf '%s WARN %s %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$code" "$msg" >>"$BASH4LLM_LOG" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

local code="${1:-INFO}" msg="${2:-}"
if [ "${QUIET:-0}" -ne 1 ]; then
  if [ "$code" = "SECURITY" ]; then
    printf '%s%sSECURITY%s: %s\n' "$(log_prefix)" "${C_BMAGENTA:-}" "${C_RST}" "$msg" >&2
  else
    printf '%s%sINFO%s: %s: %s\n' "$(log_prefix)" "${C_GREEN}" "${C_RST}" "$code" "$msg" >&2
  fi
fi
if [ -n "$BASH4LLM_LOG" ]; then
  printf '%s INFO_USER %s %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$code" "$msg" >>"$BASH4LLM_LOG" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

if [ "${DEBUG:-0}" -ne 0 ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$*" >&2
fi

local _target_var="${1:-}"
local _prompt_msg="${2:-Enter sensitive value}"
local _min_len="${3:-0}"
local _allow_verify="${4:-0}"
if [[ ! "$_target_var" =~ ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$ ]]; then
  log_error "ARGS" "Invalid target variable identifier: $_target_var"
  return 1
fi
local _is_tty=0
if [ -t 0 ] && [ -r /dev/tty ] && [ -c /dev/tty ]; then
  _is_tty=1
fi
local _stty_orig=""
if [ "$_is_tty" -eq 1 ]; then
  _stty_orig="$(stty -g < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || stty -g 2>/dev/null || true)"
fi
local _parent_trap_int="" _parent_trap_term=""
_parent_trap_int="$(trap -p INT || true)"
_parent_trap_term="$(trap -p TERM || true)"
_rsi_cleanup() {
  if [ "$_is_tty" -eq 1 ]; then
    if [ -n "$_stty_orig" ]; then
      stty "$_stty_orig" < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || stty echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || stty echo 2>/dev/null || true
    else
      stty echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || stty echo 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi
  if [ -n "$_parent_trap_int" ]; then eval "$_parent_trap_int"; else trap - INT; fi
  if [ -n "$_parent_trap_term" ]; then eval "$_parent_trap_term"; else trap - TERM; fi
}
trap '_rsi_cleanup; printf "\n" >&2; return 1' INT TERM
if [ "$_is_tty" -eq 1 ]; then
  stty -echo < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || stty -echo 2>/dev/null || true
  printf -- '%s %s[input hidden]%s: ' "$_prompt_msg" "${C_MAGENTA:-}" "${C_RST:-}" >&2
fi
local _raw_input="" _clean_input=""
if [ "$_is_tty" -eq 1 ]; then
  IFS= read -r _raw_input < /dev/tty || _raw_input=""
else
  IFS= read -r _raw_input || _raw_input=""
fi
_rsi_cleanup
if [ "$_is_tty" -eq 1 ]; then
  printf '\n' >&2
fi
_clean_input="${_raw_input//$'\r'/}"
_clean_input="${_clean_input#"${_clean_input%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
_clean_input="${_clean_input%"${_clean_input##*[![:space:]]}"}"
local _input_len="${#_clean_input}"
if [ "$_input_len" -lt "$_min_len" ]; then
  printf '  %s[ERROR] Input is too short (%d chars). Minimum required: %d.%s\n' \
    "${C_RED:-}" "$_input_len" "$_min_len" "${C_RST:-}" >&2
  printf -v "$_target_var" '%s' ""
  return 1
fi
printf -v "$_target_var" '%s' "$_clean_input"
return 0

local f="${1:-}" size=""
if [ -z "$f" ]; then
  return 1
fi
if [ ! -f "$f" ] || [ ! -r "$f" ]; then
  return 2
fi
size="$(file_size "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
if [ "$size" -eq 0 ]; then
  return 3
fi
local count=""
count="$(LC_ALL=C tr -d '\t\r\n -~\200-\377' < "$f" | wc -c)"
count="${count//[[:space:]]/}"
if [ "${count:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
  return 4
fi
return 0

local path="${1:-}"
[ -e "$path" ] || return 1
if [ "${BASH4LLM_PLAT_MACOS:-0}" -eq 1 ] || [ "${BASH4LLM_PLAT_BSD:-0}" -eq 1 ]; then
  stat -f %Sp "$path" 2>/dev/null || printf ''
else
  stat -c %A "$path" 2>/dev/null || printf ''
fi

local path="${1:-}"
[ -e "$path" ] || return 1
if [ "${BASH4LLM_PLAT_MACOS:-0}" -eq 1 ] || [ "${BASH4LLM_PLAT_BSD:-0}" -eq 1 ]; then
  stat -f %Su "$path" 2>/dev/null || printf ''
else
  stat -c %U "$path" 2>/dev/null || printf ''
fi

local target_file="${1:-}"
[ -f "$target_file" ] || return 1
[ -r "$target_file" ] || return 1
if [ -L "$target_file" ]; then
  log_error "SEC" "Symbolic link detected on file path: $target_file"
  return 1
fi
local ignore_sec=0
if [ "${BASH4LLM_PLAT_WSL:-0}" -eq 1 ] || [ "${BASH4LLM_PLAT_CYGWIN:-0}" -eq 1 ] || is_truthy "${BASH4LLM_IGNORE_SEC_CHECKS:-0}"; then
  ignore_sec=1
fi
local parent_dir
parent_dir="$(dirname "$target_file")"
local current_user owner perms group_write others_write
current_user="$(id -un 2>/dev/null || printf '')"
owner="$(_get_owner "$target_file")"
if [ -n "$owner" ] && [ "$owner" != "$current_user" ]; then
  if [ "$ignore_sec" -eq 1 ]; then
    log_warn "SEC" "Wrong owner for file: $owner (ignored due to policy/platform)"
  else
    log_error "SEC" "File owned by non-current user: $owner"
    return 1
  fi
fi
perms="$(_get_perm_string "$target_file")"
group_write="$(printf '%s' "$perms" | awk '{print substr($0,6,1)}')"
others_write="$(printf '%s' "$perms" | awk '{print substr($0,9,1)}')"
if [ "$group_write" = "w" ] || [ "$others_write" = "w" ]; then
  if [ "$ignore_sec" -eq 1 ]; then
    log_warn "SEC" "File is writable by group/world (ignored due to policy/platform)"
  else
    log_error "SEC" "File is writable by group/world: $perms"
    return 1
  fi
fi
owner="$(_get_owner "$parent_dir")"
if [ -n "$owner" ] && [ "$owner" != "$current_user" ]; then
  if [ "$ignore_sec" -eq 1 ]; then
    log_warn "SEC" "Wrong owner for parent directory: $owner (ignored due to policy/platform)"
  else
    log_error "SEC" "Parent directory owned by non-current user: $owner"
    return 1
  fi
fi
perms="$(_get_perm_string "$parent_dir")"
group_write="$(printf '%s' "$perms" | awk '{print substr($0,6,1)}')"
others_write="$(printf '%s' "$perms" | awk '{print substr($0,9,1)}')"
if [ "$group_write" = "w" ] || [ "$others_write" = "w" ]; then
  if [ "$ignore_sec" -eq 1 ]; then
    log_warn "SEC" "Parent directory is writable by group/world (ignored due to policy/platform)"
  else
    log_error "SEC" "Parent directory is writable by group/world: $perms"
    return 1
  fi
fi
return 0

local target_file="${1:-}"
[ -f "$target_file" ] || return 1
if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sha256sum "$target_file" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'
elif command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  openssl dgst -sha256 -r "$target_file" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'
elif command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  shasum -a 256 "$target_file" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'
else
  return 1
fi

local target_file="${1:-}"
local domain="${2:-vendor}"
local logical_rel_path="${3:-}"
local rel_path="" manifest_file="" expected_hash="" actual_hash=""
[ -f "$target_file" ] || return 1
if ! validate_path_security "$target_file"; then
  log_error "SEC" "Security validation failed for file path: $target_file"
  return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC:-17}"
fi
if [ "$domain" = "local" ]; then
  if [ "${DEBUG:-0}" -eq 1 ]; then
    log_info "SEC" "Local domain module verified via path security policy: $target_file"
  fi
  return 0
fi
local extras_base="${BASH4LLM_EXTRAS_DIR%/}"
manifest_file="${extras_base}/manifest.sha256"
if [ ! -f "$manifest_file" ] || [ ! -r "$manifest_file" ]; then
  log_error "SEC" "POLICY VIOLATION: Integrity manifest missing or unreadable: $manifest_file"
  return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC:-17}"
fi
if [ -n "$logical_rel_path" ]; then
  rel_path="$logical_rel_path"
else
  local canonical_extras="" canonical_target=""
  canonical_extras="$(cd "${extras_base:-.}" >/dev/null 2>&1 && pwd -P || echo "${extras_base}")"
  canonical_extras="${canonical_extras%/}"
  canonical_target="$(cd "$(dirname "$target_file")" >/dev/null 2>&1 && pwd -P || echo "")/$(basename "$target_file")"
  if [[ "$canonical_target" == "${canonical_extras}/"* ]]; then
    rel_path="${canonical_target#"${canonical_extras}/"}"
  else
    rel_path="${target_file#"${extras_base}/"}"
  fi
fi
expected_hash="$(awk -v rel="$rel_path" '{sub(/\r$/,""); sub(/^\*/,"",$2); if ($2 == rel) {print $1; exit}}' "$manifest_file" 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ -z "$expected_hash" ]; then
  log_error "SEC" "POLICY VIOLATION: Vendor module not registered in manifest: $rel_path"
  return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC:-17}"
fi
actual_hash="$(_core_sha256 "$target_file" 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ -z "$actual_hash" ]; then
  log_error "SEC" "Unable to compute SHA-256 hash for module integrity check: $target_file"
  return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC:-17}"
fi
if [ "$expected_hash" != "$actual_hash" ]; then
  log_error "SEC" "TAMPER DETECTED! Cryptographic SHA-256 mismatch for module: $rel_path"
  log_error "SEC" "Expected Hash: $expected_hash | Calculated Hash: $actual_hash"
  return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC:-17}"
fi
return 0

_B4L_SAVED_PATH="${PATH:-}"
_B4L_SAVED_IFS="${IFS:-}"
_B4L_SAVED_PWD="${PWD:-}"
_B4L_SAVED_CDPATH="${CDPATH:-}"
_B4L_SAVED_LANG="${LANG:-}"
_B4L_SAVED_LC_ALL="${LC_ALL:-}"

[ -n "${_B4L_SAVED_PATH+x}" ] && export PATH="$_B4L_SAVED_PATH"
[ -n "${_B4L_SAVED_IFS+x}" ] && export IFS="$_B4L_SAVED_IFS"
[ -n "${_B4L_SAVED_PWD+x}" ] && cd "$_B4L_SAVED_PWD" 2>/dev/null || true
[ -n "${_B4L_SAVED_CDPATH+x}" ] && export CDPATH="$_B4L_SAVED_CDPATH" || unset CDPATH 2>/dev/null || true
[ -n "${_B4L_SAVED_LANG+x}" ] && export LANG="$_B4L_SAVED_LANG" || unset LANG 2>/dev/null || true
[ -n "${_B4L_SAVED_LC_ALL+x}" ] && export LC_ALL="$_B4L_SAVED_LC_ALL" || unset LC_ALL 2>/dev/null || true
unset _B4L_SAVED_PATH _B4L_SAVED_IFS _B4L_SAVED_PWD _B4L_SAVED_CDPATH _B4L_SAVED_LANG _B4L_SAVED_LC_ALL 2>/dev/null || true

local manifest_file="${1:-}"
local sig_file="${manifest_file}.sig"
local pubkey_file="${BASH4LLM_EXTRAS_DIR%/}/official-ed25519.pub"
local errf="" rc=1
[ -f "$manifest_file" ] || return 1
if [ ! -f "$sig_file" ]; then
  if is_truthy "${BASH4LLM_REQUIRE_MANIFEST_SIG:-0}"; then
    log_error "SEC" "POLICY VIOLATION: Mandatory manifest signature missing: $sig_file"
    return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC:-17}"
  fi
  return 0
fi
if [ ! -f "$pubkey_file" ]; then
  log_error "SEC" "Manifest signature present but public key missing: $pubkey_file"
  return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC:-17}"
fi
if ! validate_path_security "$sig_file" || ! validate_path_security "$pubkey_file"; then
  log_error "SEC" "Path security check failed for signature or public key file"
  return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC:-17}"
fi
errf="$(_tmpf file "$BASH4LLM_TMPDIR" sig_err 2>/dev/null)" || return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_TMP:-15}"
if command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if openssl pkeyutl -verify -pubin -inkey "$pubkey_file" -rawin -in "$manifest_file" -sigfile "$sig_file" >"$errf" 2>&1; then
    rc=0
  else
    log_error "SEC" "CRYPTOGRAPHIC SIGNATURE FAILURE! Manifest signature verification failed via OpenSSL"
    rc="${BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC:-17}"
  fi
elif command -v ssh-keygen >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if ssh-keygen -Y verify -f "$pubkey_file" -I "bash4llm-manifest" -n "file" -s "$sig_file" < "$manifest_file" >"$errf" 2>&1; then
    rc=0
  else
    log_error "SEC" "CRYPTOGRAPHIC SIGNATURE FAILURE! Manifest signature verification failed via ssh-keygen"
    rc="${BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC:-17}"
  fi
else
  log_error "SEC" "No Ed25519 cryptographic verifier (openssl or ssh-keygen) found in PATH"
  rc="${BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC:-17}"
fi
rm -f "$errf" 2>/dev/null || true
return "$rc"

local prov="${1:-}"
local envvar="" current_key="" input_key="" custom_var="" custom_env="" prompt_msg="" read_success=0
local key_source="none" env_key_found=""
[ -n "$prov" ] || return 1
envvar="$(provider_api_env_var_name "$prov")"
custom_var="PROVIDER_API_ENV_${prov}"
if [ -n "${custom_var:-}" ] && declare -p "$custom_var" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  custom_env="${!custom_var:-}"
fi
if [ -n "${custom_env:-}" ]; then
  custom_env="${custom_env//[!a-zA-Z0-9_]/}"
  if [[ "$custom_env" =~ ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$ ]]; then
    if declare -p "$custom_env" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      envvar="$custom_env"
    fi
  fi
fi
if declare -p "$envvar" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  env_key_found="${!envvar:-}"
fi
if [ "${BASH4LLM_OPENSSL_ACTIVE:-0}" -eq 1 ] && vault_exists; then
  if [ -z "${BASH4LLM_DECRYPTED_VAULT_JSON:-}" ]; then
    log_info_user "SECURITY" "Vault file detected. Authenticating to unlock saved API keys..."
    BASH4LLM_DECRYPTED_VAULT_JSON="$(vault_load_keys)" || true
  fi
  if [ -n "${BASH4LLM_DECRYPTED_VAULT_JSON:-}" ]; then
    local extracted_key=""
    extracted_key="$(printf '%s' "${BASH4LLM_DECRYPTED_VAULT_JSON:-}" | jq -r --arg p "$prov" '.[$p] // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [ -n "$extracted_key" ]; then
      current_key="$extracted_key"
      key_source="vault"
      export "$envvar"="$current_key"
      if [ "$prov" = "groq" ] && [ "$envvar" != "GROQ_API_KEY" ]; then
        export GROQ_API_KEY="$current_key"
      fi
    else
      log_warn "SECURITY" "No saved API key found in vault for provider: $prov"
    fi
  else
    log_warn "SECURITY" "Vault authentication failed. Falling back to manual prompt."
    BASH4LLM_DECRYPTED_VAULT_JSON=""
  fi
fi
if [ -z "$current_key" ] && [ -n "$env_key_found" ] && ! is_truthy "${BASH4LLM_REQUIRE_VAULT:-0}"; then
  current_key="$env_key_found"
  key_source="env"
fi
if is_truthy "${BASH4LLM_REQUIRE_VAULT:-0}"; then
  if [ "$key_source" != "vault" ]; then
    log_error "SEC" "POLICY VIOLATION: BASH4LLM_REQUIRE_VAULT=1 is enforced, but provider '$prov' key was not retrieved from the encrypted Vault."
    return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC:-17}"
  fi
fi
if [ -n "$current_key" ]; then
  if [ "$prov" = "groq" ] && [ "$envvar" != "GROQ_API_KEY" ]; then
    export GROQ_API_KEY="$current_key"
  fi
  return 0
fi
if [ ! -t 0 ]; then
  log_error "APIKEY" "missing API key for provider $prov (env $envvar) in non-interactive mode"
  return "$BASH4LLM_ERR_NO_API_KEY"
fi
prompt_msg="Enter API key for provider $(printf '%b%s%b' "${C_BGREEN:-}" "$prov" "${C_RST:-}") (env $(printf '%b%s%b' "${C_BYELLOW:-}" "$envvar" "${C_RST:-}"))"
read_secure_input "input_key" "$prompt_msg" 1
read_success=$?
if [ "$read_success" -ne 0 ] || [ -z "$input_key" ]; then
  log_error "APIKEY" "No input received from terminal prompt. Aborting."
  return "$BASH4LLM_ERR_NO_API_KEY"
fi
export "$envvar"="$input_key"
if [ "$prov" = "groq" ] && [ "$envvar" != "GROQ_API_KEY" ]; then
  export GROQ_API_KEY="$input_key"
fi
BASH4LLM_KEY_MANUAL_PROMPT=1
export BASH4LLM_KEY_MANUAL_PROMPT
return 0

if is_truthy "${DRY_RUN:-0}" || is_truthy "${BASH4LLM_SKIP_NETWORK:-0}"; then
  if [ "${DEBUG:-0}" -eq 1 ]; then
    log_info "NETWORK" "Network calls disabled by DRY_RUN or BASH4LLM_SKIP_NETWORK; skipping HTTP."
  fi
  return 1
fi
if is_truthy "${BASH4LLM_ENFORCE_NO_NETWORK_IF_QUIET:-0}" && is_truthy "${QUIET:-0}"; then
  if [ "${DEBUG:-0}" -eq 1 ]; then
    log_info "NETWORK" "Network calls disabled due to QUIET policy."
  fi
  return 1
fi
return 0

safe_mkdir "${BASH4LLM_CONFIG_DIR}" 700
if ! : > "${BASH4LLM_CONFIG_DIR}/.bash4llm_tmp_check" 2>/dev/null; then
  log_error "CONFIG" "config dir not writable: ${BASH4LLM_CONFIG_DIR}"
  return 1
else
  rm -f "${BASH4LLM_CONFIG_DIR}/.bash4llm_tmp_check" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
return 0

local prov="${1:-}" url="${2:-}" file="" dir="" tmp=""
[ -z "$prov" ] && return 1
[ -z "$url" ] && return 1
file="$(canonical_provider_url_file)"
dir="$(dirname "$file")"
safe_mkdir "$dir" 700
if [ -f "$file" ] && [ -s "$file" ]; then
  return 0
fi
local target_tmpdir="${RUN_TMPDIR:-${BASH4LLM_TMPDIR:-}}"
if [ -z "$target_tmpdir" ] || [ ! -d "$target_tmpdir" ]; then

local lockfile="${1:-}"
local timeout="${2:-10}"
local rc=""
shift 2
if [ "$1" != "--" ]; then
  log_error "USAGE" "lock_exec <lockfile> <timeout> -- <cmd> [args...]"
  return 2
fi
shift
if [ -L "$lockfile" ]; then
  log_error "SEC" "lockfile is a symlink: $lockfile. Aborting."
  if [ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" = "$0" ]; then exit 15; else return 15; fi
fi
safe_mkdir "$(dirname "$lockfile")" 700
local use_flock=0
if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ "${BASH4LLM_PLAT_ANDROID:-0}" -eq 0 ] && [ "${BASH4LLM_PLAT_MACOS:-0}" -eq 0 ] && [ "${BASH4LLM_PLAT_BSD:-0}" -eq 0 ]; then
  use_flock=1
fi
if [ "$use_flock" -eq 1 ]; then
  (
    if flock -x -w "$timeout" 200 2>/dev/null; then
      set -e
      "$@"
    else
      log_error "LOCKTIMEOUT" "could not acquire lock on $lockfile within $timeout seconds"
      exit 124
    fi
  ) 200>"$lockfile"
  rc=$?
  return "$rc"
else
  local lockdir="${lockfile}.lockdir"
  local start_time="" now="" acquired=0 lock_pid=0 lock_ts=0 is_orphan=0
  start_time=$(date +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  while :; do
    if [ -d "$lockdir" ]; then
      lock_pid=0
      if [ -f "$lockdir/owner.pid" ]; then
        lock_pid=$(cat "$lockdir/owner.pid" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
      fi
      is_orphan=0
      if [[ "$lock_pid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [ "$lock_pid" -gt 0 ]; then
        if ! kill -0 "$lock_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
          is_orphan=1
        fi
      else
        lock_ts=0
        if [ -f "$lockdir/owner.ts" ]; then
          lock_ts=$(cat "$lockdir/owner.ts" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        fi
        now=$(date +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        if [ "$lock_ts" -gt 0 ] && [ $((now - lock_ts)) -gt 15 ]; then
          is_orphan=1
        fi
      fi
      if [ "$is_orphan" -eq 1 ]; then
        rm -rf -- "$lockdir" 2>/dev/null || true
      fi
    fi
    if mkdir "$lockdir" 2>/dev/null; then
      {
        printf '%s\n' "${BASHPID:-$$}" > "$lockdir/owner.pid"
        printf '%s\n' "$(date +%s)" > "$lockdir/owner.ts"
      } 2>/dev/null || true
      acquired=1
      break
    fi
    now=$(date +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    if [ $((now - start_time)) -ge "$timeout" ]; then
      break
    fi
    sleep 0.1 2>/dev/null || sleep 1
  done
  if [ "$acquired" -eq 1 ]; then
    (
      set -e
      "$@"
    )
    rc=$?
    rm -rf -- "$lockdir" 2>/dev/null || true
    return "$rc"
  else
    log_error "LOCKTIMEOUT" "could not acquire directory-based lock on $lockdir within $timeout seconds"
    return 124
  fi
fi

local config_file="${BASH4LLM_CONFIG_DIR}/config"
local notes_file="${BASH4LLM_EXTRAS_DIR:-}/docs/core-notes.sh"
local security_failed=0
local warnings_found=0
local perm_string=""
local group_write=""
local others_write=""
local canonical_vars=""
local key=""
local val=""
local line=""
declare -A canonical_set=()
printf '%bChecking Bash4LLM⁺ Configuration Security...%b\n' "${C_BOLD}" "${C_RST}"
if [ -f "$config_file" ]; then
  if [ "$BASH4LLM_PLAT_MACOS" -eq 1 ] || [ "$BASH4LLM_PLAT_BSD" -eq 1 ]; then
    perm_string="$(stat -f %Sp "$config_file" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  else
    perm_string="$(stat -c %A "$config_file" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  fi
  if [ -n "$perm_string" ]; then
    group_write="$(printf '%s' "$perm_string" | awk '{print substr($0,6,1)}')"
    others_write="$(printf '%s' "$perm_string" | awk '{print substr($0,9,1)}')"
    if [ "$group_write" = "w" ] || [ "$others_write" = "w" ]; then
      printf '  [%sSECURITY ERROR%s] Config file is writable by group/others: %s (%s)\n' "${C_RED}" "${C_RST}" "$config_file" "$perm_string" >&2
      security_failed=1
    else
      printf '  [%sOK%s] Configuration file permissions are secure.\n' "${C_GREEN}" "${C_RST}"
    fi
  fi
else
  printf '  [%sINFO%s] Local config file not present. Using runtime defaults.\n' "${C_CYAN}" "${C_RST}"
fi
canonical_vars="$(_extract_notes_section "Important names (use exact names):" || true)"
if [ -z "$canonical_vars" ]; then
  printf '  [%sWARNING%s] Unable to read core-notes.sh. Skipping variable linter.\n' "${C_YELLOW}" "${C_RST}" >&2
  printf '  Please install extras with: %s --install-extras\n\n' "$0" >&2
else
  while IFS= read -r var; do
    [ -n "$var" ] && canonical_set["$var"]=1
  done <<EOF
$(printf '%s' "$canonical_vars" | sed -E 's/\([^)]*\)//g; s/\.//g' | tr -d ' ' | tr ',' '\n' | grep -v '^$')
EOF
  if [ -f "$config_file" ] && [ -s "$config_file" ]; then
    printf '\n%bLinting Configuration Keys...%b\n' "${C_BOLD}" "${C_RST}"
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
      case "$line" in ''|\#*) continue ;; esac
      key="${line%%=*}"
      key="${key#"${key%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
      key="${key%"${key##*[![:space:]]}"}"
      if [ -n "$key" ]; then
        if [ "$key" = "TEMP" ]; then
          printf '  [%sWARNING%s] Restricted variable "TEMP" detected. Please use "TURE" or "TEMPERATURE" to avoid conflicts with temporary paths.\n' "${C_YELLOW}" "${C_RST}"
          warnings_found=$((warnings_found + 1))
        elif [ -z "${canonical_set[$key]:-}" ]; then
          printf '  [%sWARNING%s] Unknown or typo-prone variable found: "%s"\n' "${C_YELLOW}" "${C_RST}" "$key"
          warnings_found=$((warnings_found + 1))
        fi
      fi
    done < "$config_file"
  fi
fi
if [ "$security_failed" -eq 1 ]; then
  printf '\n%sCRITICAL ERROR%s: Security validation failed. Fix directory/file permissions before running.\n' "${C_RED}" "${C_RST}" >&2
  exit "$BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC"
fi
if [ "$warnings_found" -gt 0 ]; then
  printf '\nConfiguration scan completed with %d warnings. Active execution is safe.\n' "$warnings_found"
else
  printf '\n%sConfiguration is secure and valid.%s\n' "${C_GREEN}" "${C_RST}"
fi

  log_error "ARGS" "Option --explain-error requires an error code or alias argument"
  exit 2
fi
error_defs="$(_extract_notes_section "Error Code Constants & Direct Alias Mappings:" || true)"
operational_tips="$(_extract_notes_section "OPERATIONAL TIPS (concise)" || true)"
if [ -z "$error_defs" ]; then
  log_warn "DOCS" "Unable to load core-notes.sh document. Cannot explain error."
  printf 'Please install extras with: %s --install-extras\n' "$0" >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf '%bEvaluating error code / alias: %s%b\n\n' "${C_BOLD}" "$input_code" "${C_RST}"
matched="$(printf '%s' "$error_defs" | grep -E "\b${input_code}\b" || true)"
if [ -n "$matched" ]; then
  printf '%sFormal definition found:%s\n' "${C_GREEN}" "${C_RST}"
  printf '  %s\n\n' "$matched"
  printf '%sOperational Mitigation Advice:%s\n' "${C_CYAN}" "${C_RST}"
  if [ "$input_code" = "15" ] || [[ "$input_code" == *"BASH4LLM_ERR_TMP"* ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$operational_tips" | grep -Ei "perm|temp|tmp|_tmpf" || printf '%s\n' "$operational_tips"
  elif [ "$input_code" = "10" ] || [[ "$input_code" == *"BASH4LLM_ERR_NO_API_KEY"* ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$operational_tips" | grep -Ei "api|key|prov" || printf '%s\n' "$operational_tips"
  elif [ "$input_code" = "17" ] || [[ "$input_code" == *"BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC"* ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$operational_tips" | grep -Ei "perm|chmod|sec|check" || printf '%s\n' "$operational_tips"
  else
    printf '%s\n' "$operational_tips"
  fi
else
  printf 'No exact documentation mapping found for: %s\n' "$input_code" >&2
fi

local raw_prov="${1:-}"
local domain="" name="" vendor_path="" local_path=""
[ -n "$raw_prov" ] || return 1
if [[ "$raw_prov" == *":"* ]]; then
  domain="${raw_prov%%:*}"
  name="${raw_prov#*:}"
  name="${name//[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/}"
  [ -n "$name" ] || return 1
  case "$domain" in
    builtin)
      printf '%s|builtin|%s' "embedded" "$name"
      return 0
      ;;
    vendor)
      vendor_path="${PROVIDERS_DIR}/${name}.sh"
      if [ ! -f "$vendor_path" ]; then
        log_error "PROVIDER" "Vendor provider '$name' module not found at: $vendor_path"
        return 1
      fi
      printf '%s|vendor|%s' "$vendor_path" "$name"
      return 0
      ;;
    local)
      local_path="${LOCAL_PROVIDERS_DIR}/${name}.sh"
      if [ ! -f "$local_path" ]; then
        log_error "PROVIDER" "Local provider '$name' module not found at: $local_path"
        return 1
      fi
      printf '%s|local|%s' "$local_path" "$name"
      return 0
      ;;
    *)
      log_error "PROVIDER" "Invalid provider domain prefix: $domain"
      return 1
      ;;
  esac
else
  name="${raw_prov//[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/}"
  [ -n "$name" ] || return 1
  vendor_path="${PROVIDERS_DIR}/${name}.sh"
  local_path="${LOCAL_PROVIDERS_DIR}/${name}.sh"
  if [ -f "$vendor_path" ] && [ -f "$local_path" ]; then
    log_warn "PROVIDER" "Local provider shadows vendor provider. Using vendor provider. Use '--provider local:${name}' or '--provider vendor:${name}' to disambiguate."
  fi
  if [ -f "$vendor_path" ]; then
    printf '%s|vendor|%s' "$vendor_path" "$name"
    return 0
  elif [ -f "$local_path" ]; then
    printf '%s|local|%s' "$local_path" "$name"
    return 0
  else
    printf '%s|builtin|%s' "embedded" "$name"
    return 0
  fi
fi

local provider_raw="${1:-}"
local resolved="" resolved_path="" resolved_domain="" provider=""
local current_user="" beforesig="" aftersig="" dump_file="" staged_file="" rc=0 _nounset_was_on=0
local supports_streaming=0 supports_refresh_models=0 loaded_from="" prov_json="" logical_rel_path="" prov_api_ver=""
_provider_env_snapshot
resolved="$(_resolve_provider_module_path "$provider_raw" 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ -z "$resolved" ]; then
  log_error "PROVIDER" "Failed to resolve provider path for: $provider_raw"
  _provider_env_restore
  return 1
fi
IFS='|' read -r resolved_path resolved_domain provider <<EOF
$resolved
EOF
if [ "${LOADED_PROVIDER_NAME:-}" = "$provider" ] && [ "${PROVIDER_MODULE_LOADED:-0}" -eq 1 ]; then
  PROVIDER="$provider"
  sync_models_file_path "$provider"
  _provider_env_restore
  return 0
fi
LOADED_PROVIDER_NAME="$provider"
PROVIDER="$provider"
PROVIDER_MODULE_LOADED=0
if [ "$resolved_domain" = "builtin" ]; then
  PROVIDER_MODULE_LOADED=1
  sync_models_file_path "$provider"
  _provider_env_restore
  return 0
fi
PROVIDER_MODULE_PATH="$resolved_path"
if [ "$resolved_domain" = "vendor" ]; then
  if ! _verify_manifest_signature "${BASH4LLM_EXTRAS_DIR%/}/manifest.sha256"; then
    log_error "SEC" "Manifest signature verification failed for vendor domain"
    _provider_env_restore
    return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC:-17}"
  fi
  logical_rel_path="providers/${provider}.sh"
fi
staged_file="$(_tmpf file "$BASH4LLM_TMPDIR" "staged.${provider}" 2>/dev/null)"
if [ -z "$staged_file" ]; then
  log_error "TMP" "Failed to allocate staging copy file for provider $provider"
  _provider_env_restore
  return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_TMP:-15}"
fi
if ! cp -f "$PROVIDER_MODULE_PATH" "$staged_file" 2>/dev/null; then
  rm -f "$staged_file" 2>/dev/null || true
  log_error "TMP" "Failed to create staging copy of provider module: $PROVIDER_MODULE_PATH"
  _provider_env_restore
  return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_TMP:-15}"
fi
chmod 600 "$staged_file" 2>/dev/null || true
if ! verify_module_integrity "$staged_file" "$resolved_domain" "$logical_rel_path"; then
  rm -f "$staged_file" 2>/dev/null || true
  log_error "SEC" "Staged provider module failed $resolved_domain domain verification: $PROVIDER_MODULE_PATH"
  _provider_env_restore
  return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC:-17}"
fi
if bash -n "$staged_file" 2>/dev/null; then
  dump_file="$(_mktemp_in_dir "$BASH4LLM_TMPDIR" "provdump.${provider}.XXXXXX" 2>/dev/null)"
  [ -z "$dump_file" ] && { rm -f "$staged_file" 2>/dev/null || true; log_error "SEC" "Cannot create provider dump file"; _provider_env_restore; return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC:-17}"; }
  (
    set -e
    trap 'rm -f "$dump_file.before.$$" "$dump_file.after.$$" "$dump_file.funcs.$$" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
    declare -F | awk '{print $3}' | sort > "$dump_file.before.$$" 2>/dev/null || true
    . "$staged_file"
    declare -F | awk '{print $3}' | sort > "$dump_file.after.$$" 2>/dev/null || true
    comm -13 "$dump_file.before.$$" "$dump_file.after.$$" > "$dump_file.funcs.$$" 2>/dev/null || true
    req1="buildpayload_${provider}"
    req2="call_api_${provider}"
    for f in "$req1" "$req2"; do
      if ! grep -xq "$f" "$dump_file.funcs.$$" 2>/dev/null; then
        if ! type "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          log_error "PROVIDER" "Provider '$provider' missing required function: $f"
          exit 99
        fi
      fi
    done
    if [ -n "${BASH4LLM_PROVIDER_API_VERSION:-}" ]; then
      if [ "$BASH4LLM_PROVIDER_API_VERSION" -gt "${BASH4LLM_SUPPORTED_PROVIDER_API:-1}" ]; then
        log_error "PROVIDER" "Provider '$provider' requires unsupported API version $BASH4LLM_PROVIDER_API_VERSION (Core supports max ${BASH4LLM_SUPPORTED_PROVIDER_API:-1})"
        exit 98
      fi
    fi
    : > "$dump_file"
    while IFS= read -r fn; do
      [ -z "$fn" ] && continue
      case "$fn" in
        buildpayload_${provider}|\
        call_api_${provider}|\
        call_api_streaming_${provider}|\
        refresh_models_${provider}|\
        validate_model_${provider}|\
        validate_key_${provider}|\
        auto_select_model_${provider}|\
        normalize_model_${provider})
          if type "$fn" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            declare -f "$fn" >> "$dump_file"
          fi
          ;;
        *)
          log_warn "SECURITY" "Blocked unauthorized function export from provider '$provider': $fn"
          ;;
      esac
    done < "$dump_file.funcs.$$"
  )
  rc=$?
  rm -f "$staged_file" 2>/dev/null || true
  if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
    log_error "PROVIDER" "Provider module failed isolated import (rc=$rc)"
    rm -f "$dump_file" 2>/dev/null || true
    _provider_env_restore
    return "${BASH4LLM_ERR_SEC:-17}"
  fi
  _nounset_was_on=0
  if (set -o | awk '/^nounset/ {print $2}' 2>/dev/null | grep -q on); then
    _nounset_was_on=1
    set +u
  fi
  . "$dump_file"
  if [ "$_nounset_was_on" -eq 1 ]; then
    set -u
  fi
  PROVIDER_MODULE_LOADED=1
  rm -f "$dump_file" 2>/dev/null || true
else
  rm -f "$staged_file" 2>/dev/null || true
  log_warn "PROVIDER" "Provider module invalid syntax; falling back to embedded provider."
  PROVIDER_MODULE_LOADED=0
fi
if [ -n "${provider:-}" ]; then
  supports_streaming=0
  supports_refresh_models=0
  if type "call_api_streaming_${provider}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then supports_streaming=1; fi
  if type "refresh_models_${provider}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then supports_refresh_models=1; fi
  loaded_from="${PROVIDER_MODULE_PATH:-embedded}"
  prov_json="$(jq -c -n --arg p "$provider" --arg domain "$resolved_domain" --arg loaded "$loaded_from" --argjson sstream "$supports_streaming" --argjson srefresh "$supports_refresh_models" '{provider:$p, domain:$domain, supports_streaming:$sstream, supports_refresh_models:$srefresh, loaded_from:$loaded}')"
  ui_state_write "provider_capabilities.json" "$prov_json" || log_warn "UI_STATE" "Failed to write provider_capabilities for $provider"
fi
sync_models_file_path "$provider"
_provider_env_restore
return 0

B64_WRAP_OPT=""
B64_DECODE_OPT="-d"
if printf '' | base64 -w0 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  B64_WRAP_OPT="-w0"
else
  B64_WRAP_OPT=""
fi
if printf 'dGVzdA==' | base64 -d 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'test'; then
  B64_DECODE_OPT="-d"
elif printf 'dGVzdA==' | base64 -D 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'test'; then
  B64_DECODE_OPT="-D"
else
  B64_DECODE_OPT="-d"
fi
export B64_WRAP_OPT B64_DECODE_OPT

local f="${1:-}"
if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then printf '0'; return 0; fi
if [ "${BASH4LLM_PLAT_MACOS:-0}" -eq 1 ] || [ "${BASH4LLM_PLAT_BSD:-0}" -eq 1 ]; then
  stat -f %m "$f" 2>/dev/null || printf '0'
else
  stat -c %Y "$f" 2>/dev/null || printf '0'
fi

local filter="${1:-}" file="${2:-}" rc=""
if [ -z "$file" ] || [ ! -s "$file" ]; then
  return 1
fi
if ! jq -e "$filter" "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  rc=$?
  if [ -n "${ERRF:-}" ]; then
    jq "$filter" "$file" 2>>"$ERRF" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
  return "$rc"
fi
return 0

if [ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" = "$0" ]; then
  set -euo pipefail
fi
unset BASH_ENV ENV CDPATH GLOBIGNORE
ulimit -c 0 2>/dev/null || true
SCRIPT_NAME="bash4llm"
SCRIPT_VERSION="2.8.5.3"
SCRIPT_DATE="2026-08-16"
BASH4LLM_SUPPORTED_PROVIDER_API=1
export BASH4LLM_SUPPORTED_PROVIDER_API

BASH4LLM_PLAT_ANDROID=0
BASH4LLM_PLAT_MACOS=0
BASH4LLM_PLAT_WSL=0
BASH4LLM_PLAT_CYGWIN=0
BASH4LLM_PLAT_BSD=0
BASH4LLM_PLAT_LINUX=0
_uname_s="$(uname -s 2>/dev/null || echo "Linux")"
_uname_o="$(uname -o 2>/dev/null || echo "")"
_uname_r="$(uname -r 2>/dev/null || echo "")"
if [ -n "${TERMUX_VERSION:-}" ] || [ -d "/data/data/com.termux" ] || [[ "$_uname_o" == *"Android"* ]] || [[ "$(uname -a 2>/dev/null)" == *"Android"* ]] || [ -f /system/build.prop ]; then
  BASH4LLM_PLAT_ANDROID=1
elif [ "$_uname_s" = "Darwin" ]; then
  BASH4LLM_PLAT_MACOS=1
elif [[ "$_uname_s" == *"CYGWIN"* ]] || [[ "$_uname_s" == *"MSYS"* ]] || [[ "$_uname_s" == *"MINGW"* ]]; then
  BASH4LLM_PLAT_CYGWIN=1
elif [[ "$_uname_s" == *"BSD"* ]] || [ "$_uname_s" = "DragonFly" ]; then
  BASH4LLM_PLAT_BSD=1
elif [[ "$_uname_r" == *"microsoft"* ]] || [[ "$_uname_r" == *"Microsoft"* ]]; then
  BASH4LLM_PLAT_WSL=1
  BASH4LLM_PLAT_LINUX=1
else
  BASH4LLM_PLAT_LINUX=1
fi
export BASH4LLM_PLAT_ANDROID BASH4LLM_PLAT_MACOS BASH4LLM_PLAT_WSL BASH4LLM_PLAT_CYGWIN BASH4LLM_PLAT_BSD BASH4LLM_PLAT_LINUX
BASH4LLM_KEY_MANUAL_PROMPT=0
VALIDATE_SML=0
VALIDATE_REGEX=""
SANITIZE_OUTPUT=0
JSON_DIAGNOSTICS=0
declare -A BASH4LLM_MODEL_CACHE=()

if [ -z "${BASH_VERSINFO[0]:-}" ] || [ "${BASH_VERSINFO[0]}" -lt 4 ]; then
  printf 'bash4llm: FATAL ERROR: Bash 4.0 or superior is required to run this script.\n' >&2
  exit 15
fi
for cmd in bash jq curl mktemp stat base64 find awk sed grep xargs tr sort head wc tee date mv chmod cp rm printf comm; do
  if ! command -v "$cmd" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'bash4llm: FATAL ERROR: required system utility not found in PATH: %s\n' "$cmd" >&2
    exit 15
  fi
done

SCRIPTDIR="$(resolve_script_dir)"
if [ -n "${BASH4LLM_DIR:-}" ]; then
  :
elif [ -n "${BASH4LLM_ROOT:-}" ]; then
  BASH4LLM_DIR="${BASH4LLM_ROOT%/}/bash4llm.d"
else
  BASH4LLM_DIR="$SCRIPTDIR/bash4llm.d"
fi
BASH4LLM_CONFIG_DIR="${BASH4LLM_CONFIG_DIR:-${BASH4LLM_DIR}/config}"
BASH4LLM_MODELS_DIR="${BASH4LLM_MODELS_DIR:-${BASH4LLM_DIR}/models}"
BASH4LLM_TEMPLATES_DIR="${BASH4LLM_TEMPLATES_DIR:-${BASH4LLM_DIR}/templates}"
BASH4LLM_HISTORY_DIR="${BASH4LLM_HISTORY_DIR:-${BASH4LLM_DIR}/history}"
BASH4LLM_TMPDIR="${BASH4LLM_TMPDIR:-${BASH4LLM_DIR}/tmp}"
BASH4LLM_RUN_DIR="${BASH4LLM_RUN_DIR:-${BASH4LLM_DIR}/var/run}"
BASH4LLM_LOCKS_DIR="${BASH4LLM_LOCKS_DIR:-${BASH4LLM_RUN_DIR}/locks}"
sync_models_file_path
MAX_MODELS="${MAX_MODELS:-200}"
CANONICAL_EXTRAS_DIR="${BASH4LLM_DIR}/extras"
LEGACY_EXTRAS_DIR="${SCRIPTDIR%/}/extras"
BASH4LLM_EXTRAS_DIR="${BASH4LLM_EXTRAS_DIR:-${CANONICAL_EXTRAS_DIR}}"
PROVIDERS_DIR="${PROVIDERS_DIR:-${BASH4LLM_EXTRAS_DIR}/providers}"
CANONICAL_LOCAL_EXTRAS_DIR="${BASH4LLM_DIR}/local-extras"
BASH4LLM_LOCAL_EXTRAS_DIR="${BASH4LLM_LOCAL_EXTRAS_DIR:-${CANONICAL_LOCAL_EXTRAS_DIR}}"
LOCAL_PROVIDERS_DIR="${LOCAL_PROVIDERS_DIR:-${BASH4LLM_LOCAL_EXTRAS_DIR}/providers}"
export BASH4LLM_EXTRAS_DIR PROVIDERS_DIR BASH4LLM_LOCAL_EXTRAS_DIR LOCAL_PROVIDERS_DIR BASH4LLM_RUN_DIR BASH4LLM_LOCKS_DIR
if [ -z "${BASH4LLM_DIR:-}" ]; then
  printf 'bash4llm: ERROR: BASH4LLM_DIR is empty; cannot derive directories\n' >&2
  exit "${BASH4LLM_ERR_TMP:-15}"
fi
case "${BASH4LLM_DIR:-}" in
  /tmp|/tmp/*)
    printf 'bash4llm: ERROR: BASH4LLM_DIR must not be /tmp or under /tmp: %s\n' "${BASH4LLM_DIR}" >&2
    exit "${BASH4LLM_ERR_TMP:-15}"
    ;;
esac
if [ "${BASH4LLM_SOURCE_ONLY:-0}" -ne 1 ] && [ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" = "$0" ]; then
  safe_mkdir "$BASH4LLM_DIR" 700
  safe_mkdir "$BASH4LLM_CONFIG_DIR" 700
  safe_mkdir "$BASH4LLM_MODELS_DIR" 700
  safe_mkdir "$BASH4LLM_TEMPLATES_DIR" 700
  safe_mkdir "$BASH4LLM_HISTORY_DIR" 700
  safe_mkdir "$BASH4LLM_TMPDIR" 700
  safe_mkdir "$BASH4LLM_RUN_DIR" 700
  safe_mkdir "$BASH4LLM_LOCKS_DIR" 700
  safe_mkdir "$BASH4LLM_EXTRAS_DIR" 700
  safe_mkdir "$PROVIDERS_DIR" 700
  safe_mkdir "$BASH4LLM_LOCAL_EXTRAS_DIR" 700
  safe_mkdir "$LOCAL_PROVIDERS_DIR" 700
  safe_mkdir "$BASH4LLM_CONFIG_DIR/providers" 700
  safe_mkdir "$BASH4LLM_HISTORY_DIR/threads" 700
fi
THREAD_DIR="${BASH4LLM_HISTORY_DIR}/threads"
export TMPDIR="${BASH4LLM_TMPDIR:-}"
if [ -n "${BASH4LLM_TMPDIR:-}" ]; then
  BASH4LLM_RATES_DIR="${BASH4LLM_TMPDIR}/rates"
  export BASH4LLM_RATES_DIR
fi
if [ "${BASH4LLM_SOURCE_ONLY:-0}" -ne 1 ] && [ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" = "$0" ]; then
  safe_mkdir "${BASH4LLM_TMPDIR:-}" 700
  if [ -n "${BASH4LLM_RATES_DIR:-}" ]; then
    safe_mkdir "${BASH4LLM_RATES_DIR}" 700
  fi
fi

_BASH4LLM_OPENSSL_HELPER="${BASH4LLM_EXTRAS_DIR:-}/security/openssl-helper.sh"
if [ "${BASH4LLM_VAULT_ENABLED:-1}" -eq 1 ]; then
  if [ -f "$_BASH4LLM_OPENSSL_HELPER" ] && [ -r "$_BASH4LLM_OPENSSL_HELPER" ]; then
    if verify_module_integrity "$_BASH4LLM_OPENSSL_HELPER"; then
      if . "$_BASH4LLM_OPENSSL_HELPER" 2>/dev/null; then
        if [ "${BASH4LLM_OPENSSL_ACTIVE:-0}" -eq 1 ]; then
          export BASH4LLM_OPENSSL_ACTIVE
        fi
      fi
    else
      log_error "SEC" "Refusing to load untrusted OpenSSL helper module: $_BASH4LLM_OPENSSL_HELPER"
      BASH4LLM_OPENSSL_ACTIVE=0
    fi
  fi
else
  BASH4LLM_OPENSSL_ACTIVE=0
fi

if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
  i=1
  while [ "$i" -le "$#" ]; do
    arg="${!i}"
    case "$arg" in
      --check-config)
        run_static_config_check
        exit 0
        ;;
      --explain-error)
        next_index=$((i+1))
        if [ "$next_index" -le "$#" ]; then
          explain_error_code "${!next_index}"
          exit 0
        else
          log_error "ARGS" "Usage: --explain-error <error_code_or_alias>"
          exit 2
        fi
        ;;
      --print-config-dir)
        printf '%s\n' "$(canonical_config_dir)"
        exit 0
        ;;
      --print-provider-file)
        printf '%s\n' "$(canonical_provider_file)"
        exit 0
        ;;
      --print-model-file)
        next_index=$((i+1))
        if [ "$next_index" -le "$#" ]; then
          prov="${!next_index}"
          printf '%s\n' "$(canonical_model_file "$prov")"
          exit 0
        else
          log_error "ARGS" "Usage: --print-model-file <provider>"
          exit 2
        fi
        ;;
      --print-model-file=*)
        prov="${arg#--print-model-file=}"
        printf '%s\n' "$(canonical_model_file "$prov")"
        exit 0
        ;;
      --help|-h)
        break
        ;;
      *)
        ;;
    esac
    i=$((i+1))
  done
fi
